summary.name: MangoDisk
summary.one_liner: MangoDisk is a free, open-source disk cleaner and space analyzer for Windows and macOS that scans locally and shows file paths and sizes before anything is deleted.
use_cases: Find large files and folders taking up disk space
Clear caches and privacy traces on Windows or Mac
Review what a cache or file does before deleting it
Monitor CPU, memory, network and disk activity from the taskbar or desktop
Manage installed apps and clear usage history
summary.what_it_does: MangoDisk scans a chosen disk or folder and shows disk usage in blocks sized by space used, letting you open folders and find large files. It lists file locations and risk information, and you pick what to remove and check the selection before cleaning. Optional AI explanations describe what a file or cache does and how removing it could affect apps. It also offers a system monitor for CPU, memory, network and disk activity in a Windows taskbar or floating desktop layout, and a History log of past actions. The page says scanning and cleanup run on the local computer and that no account is required.
notable: Open source and free, no sign-up required
Scans and cleans locally, showing paths and sizes before deletion
Optional AI explanations of files and caches
Taskbar or floating desktop system monitor for CPU, memory, network and disk
caveats: Speed and free-space comparisons are the vendor's own benchmarks on unspecified test setups
AI explanations are optional and rely on an AI service the page does not describe in detail
